app_info.subtitle: Analyze Exact Online finance
app_info.description: DataFlowr connects ChatGPT to a user's Exact Online administration to retrieve and analyze financial, CRM, project, sales, banking, asset, and document data; create and maintain selected ERP records; and run month-end close and cash-flow forecasting workflows.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the authenticated Exact Online user's profile and active-division information without changing ERP records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private DataFlowr, Exact Online, or bundled reference data and does not publish content to the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to a bounded private workspace: the authenticated user's own Exact Online administration. The new customer or supplier record is visible only to people who already have access to that administration; the tool does not contact the customer or supplier or publish anything. Exact Online is externally hosted, but per the Apps SDK reference a bounded private account or workspace is not open-world solely because it is externally hosted.

test_cases.description: Build a management income statement for a named Exact Online administration.
test_cases.user_prompt: For DataFlowr B.V., show the June 2026 income statement with period and year-to-date values, each compared with the prior year.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the named administration and returns one structured income statement with period, year-to-date, and prior-year comparisons.

test_cases.description: Review overdue customer balances and aging concentration.
test_cases.user_prompt: For DataFlowr B.V., show outstanding customer receivables by aging bucket and identify the accounts with the largest overdue balances.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the receivables aging buckets and highlights the largest overdue customer balances without changing ERP data.

test_cases.description: Create a sales invoice after resolving the required Exact Online references.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a sales invoice in DataFlowr B.V. for customer Acme B.V. with one consulting line for 10 hours at EUR 150, using the normal sales journal and VAT code.
test_cases.tools_triggered: exact_online_divisions, exact_online_accounts_list, exact_online_journals_list, exact_online_items_list, exact_online_vat_codes_list, exact_online_sales_invoices_create
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the customer and accounting references, requests confirmation for the write, and returns the created invoice details after approval.

test_cases.description: Run and retrieve a hosted month-end close assessment.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run the full month-end close assessment for DataFlowr B.V. for financial period 6 of 2026 and give me the complete findings report when it finishes.
test_cases.expected_output: Starts the close workflow, polls its returned conversation key, and presents the complete readiness report with findings and recommendations.

test_cases.description: Produce a rolling cash-flow forecast and exercise asynchronous status handling.
test_cases.user_prompt: For DataFlowr B.V., produce a 12-month rolling cash-flow forecast after financial period 6 of 2026, using Exact Online budgets where available.
test_cases.expected_output: Starts the forecast workflow, polls when necessary, and returns the forecast timeline, assumptions, model choices, and narrative.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for calendar management.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow, and can you move my first one to Friday?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no calendar access or scheduling workflow.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app to initiate a bank transfer.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Transfer EUR 5,000 from my bank account to a supplier today.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it can inspect payment and banking records but cannot initiate bank transfers.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app to file a tax return with a government authority.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Submit my Dutch VAT return to the tax authority for this quarter.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it can analyze VAT data but cannot file returns with tax authorities.
